headline: Uzbekistan customs reports 2.7-fold surge in transit truck traffic with Kazakhstan
summary: Uzbekistan's Customs Committee reported that daily truck traffic between Uzbekistan and Kazakhstan rose to 3,130 vehicles, driven by growing regional trade transit.
why: Uzbekistan and Kazakhstan form key trade corridors linking Central Asian goods to European and Chinese supply networks.

impacts.name: Uzbekistan
impacts.why: Surging transit volumes reflect expanding regional trade activity.
